unavailable.title: The terminal is not available here
unavailable.unknown: Claudio could not tell why. Check Settings → Access & safety.
unavailable.off: The terminal is off. Turn it on in Settings → Access & safety.
unavailable.disabled-by-env: The terminal is turned off by the environment (CLAUDIO_TERMINAL).
unavailable.pty-missing: This install has no pseudo-terminal support, so no shell can be started.
unavailable.host-failed: The terminal host failed repeatedly. Restart Claudio, or turn the terminal off and on again.
unavailable.read-only: Claudio is in read-only mode, which does not allow a shell.
unavailable.needs-auth: The terminal needs access protected by a token.
unavailable.remote-off: The terminal is set to open on this machine only.
unavailable.needs-tunnel: From another device the terminal opens only through the tunnel. To allow any device, change it on this machine or through the tunnel.
unavailable.from-agent: A terminal cannot be opened from a process an agent started.
unavailable.chat-token: A chat's token cannot open a terminal.

limits.off: A terminal opens only on this machine. Other devices cannot open one.
limits.tunnel: A terminal opens on this machine, and from other devices only through the tunnel with a token.
limits.any: Any device that reaches this address with a token can open a shell on this machine.

notices.pasteBlocked: The browser did not allow reading the clipboard. Paste with Ctrl+Shift+V instead.
notices.pasteTooLarge: That paste is over 1 MiB, so nothing was pasted.

new.choose: Choose where to open the terminal

list.none: No terminal is open. Open one to get a shell here.
list.failed: The terminals could not be read.

page.title: Terminals
page.notFound: This terminal is not there any more.

settings.title: Terminal
settings.intro: Your own shell, in the project's directory or a chat's worktree. It is for you, beside Claude Code: Claudio never types into it or reads it.
settings.fromEnv: Set by the environment; change it there.
settings.remoteHint: This machine can always open a terminal. Other devices need a token.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save the terminal settings
settings.shellHint: A login shell, with the tool credentials from the vault (GitHub, GitLab, YouTrack). Never Claude's own credentials or Claudio's variables.
settings.agentReach: Warning: with authentication off, an agent that has a shell can reach the terminal, because a detached process leaves its chat's process tree. With token or OIDC authentication it cannot.
settings.peerOn: The peer check runs: a process an agent started cannot open a terminal.
settings.peerUnknown: The peer check cannot run here, so a terminal opens only from this machine without authentication.
settings.screenReaderHint: Makes the terminal readable to a screen reader, at some cost in speed. Kept in this browser.

consequence.maxTerminals_one: Up to {{formatted}} terminal open at once.
consequence.maxTerminals_other: Up to {{formatted}} terminals open at once.

history.title: Terminal history
history.noneHint: Every terminal opened, and every attempt that was turned away, is listed here. Never what was typed or printed.

window.elsewhereHint: This terminal is open in a window of its own. Closing that window leaves the shell running.
window.blocked: The browser blocked the window. Allow pop-ups for Claudio and try again.
